verdict.rationale: Penpot's pricing page offers unlimited teams for free collaboration and no file limits within storage capacity, and a community user confirms you can use the free hosted instance or self-deploy. Core editor features such as components and prototyping are documented, and hands-on users describe it as easy to work with, though several report lag, crashes and performance drops on complex or large files. Missing for 10: pricing evidence that explicitly ties these features to a no-cost seat, stated storage limits for the free tier, and consistent independent confirmation that the editor stays usable on complex work.
